department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
beneficiary: Unbanked persons seeking a basic savings bank deposit account
benefits: Basic savings bank account with no minimum balance requirement
Accident insurance cover as applicable to the RuPay card
Overdraft facility up to ₹10,000 for eligible account holders
Access to DBT, insurance and pension-linked services
eligibility: A person who does not have another bank account can open a basic savings bank deposit account, subject to bank and scheme rules.
required_documents: Officially accepted identity/address documents as required by the bank
application_process: Visit a participating bank branch or Business Correspondent/Bank Mitra outlet and request a PMJDY account.
source_type: Department of Financial Services, Government of India
